title: Arizona Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 33, Chapter 10)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 33 index: 'Chapter 10: Arizona Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (Sections 33-1301 to 33-1381)', covering general provisions, landlord obligations, tenant obligations, remedies and retaliatory action; the index also shows 'Chapter 11: Arizona Mobile Home Parks Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (Sections 33-1401 to 33-1501)'. Compilation updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session.
notes: Mobile-home park tenancies are governed by the separate Chapter 11. General consumer protection is the Consumer Fraud Act in Title 44, ch. 10, art. 7, which was not examined; only one statute per topic is listed.
